final_answer:
ZeroWire Companion identifies **Django (pip/PyPI)** as affected:

| Affected versions | First fixed version |
|---|---|
| 4.2–4.2.19 | 4.2.20 |
| 5.0–5.0.12 | 5.0.13 |
| 5.1–5.1.6 | 5.1.7 |

**Risk:** Very long strings passed to `django.utils.text.wrap()` or the `wordwrap` template filter can cause denial of service.

**Action:** Check your deployed version and upgrade beyond these fixed minimums. Until patched, limit untrusted input lengths before wrapping.

**Sources:** Companion’s [GitHub advisory evidence](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-p3fp-8748-vqfq) and [Django’s official advisory](https://www.djangoproject.com/weblog/2025/mar/06/security-releases/). Django also notes affected development/5.2 prerelease code. Companion has no dedicated Zero Wire briefing for this CVE; package matching alone doesn’t confirm your deployment is affected.
